translation.english_text: (Kalyani and her husband rejoice, singing in refined Tamil in a grove where the mango-cuckoo calls.)
notes: `பைந்தமிழ் பண்பாடி` is rendered as `singing in refined Tamil`; the source's poetic register is not expanded into additional action.

english_lines: தங்: The lamp that kindles light in this life—
The form of the queen of my heart.
கல்: The one who shines as the flame within this lamp—
The form of the valiant one.
தங்: The form of a youthful peacock.
கல்: The lamp that kindles light in this life—
தங்: O fruit! O sugarcane-sweet Tamil! O nectar!
O flower on which dew sleeps! O moon!
கல்: With your tender words, you have captivated me,
தங்: When I see you, the feeling that wells within my heart—
There are no letters with which a writer could set it down.
இரு: Like this festive day, every day let us dance and sing,
And live as sweetly as honey. (In this life
notes: This is a semantic translation, not a singable adaptation.
The exact source speaker labels `தங்`, `கல்`, and `இரு` are retained inline because the verified song text is speaker-labelled.
The source refrain fragment `(இல்` is represented as `(In this life` without silently reconstructing a complete refrain.
`இள மாமயில்` is rendered literally as `a youthful peacock`; no gendered substitution is introduced.
